title: Marquee Loop
concept: Nocturne, a fictional European sleeper-train operator: a framed night-palette hero stacking three seamless CSS loops — a departures ticker, fixed-width route cards that pause on hover/focus, and reversed passenger notes — over a still, readable timetable.
notes: Pure CSS marquees (duplicated groups, translate 0 → -50%, edge masks); reduced motion swaps to a static wrap. Images are the skill's demo assets, duotone-graded to the night palette.
